messages.subject: Infrastructure & Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Susan,

Gaia Global's executive-search work across infrastructure and energy makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across government/regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where responsible development, institutional engagement and complex project execution intersect.

My executive CV is attached for your consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
